title: Signature: Conflict simulation
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): before changing a policy, the simulator shows what would break: which requests flip decisions, which workflows lose access, which obligations go unmet. Simulation makes policy change reviewable instead of scary. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers simulating policy changes pre-deployment.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 100, 2: 1000, 3: 10000}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
import random
random.seed(81)
flips = sum(1 for _ in range(N) if random.random() < 0.02)
print("requests:", N, "| would flip:", flips, "| change:", "RISKY" if flips > N * 0.05 else "safe")

title: Signature: Conflict aging
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): unresolved conflicts age, and aging escalates them: a week-old conflict pages louder than a day-old one. Aging prevents conflicts from being detected and then forgotten. Escalation continues until resolution or explicit risk acceptance. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers escalation with conflict age.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 1, 2: 8, 3: 45}
age = CFG[LEVEL]
level = "info" if age < 7 else ("page" if age < 30 else "EXECUTIVE ESCALATION")
print("conflict age: %d days ->" % age, level)

title: Signature: Policy intent capture
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): every policy records its intent in plain language: what problem it solves and what it must never break. Intent guides conflict resolution: when two rules clash, the resolution preserves both intents if possible. Intentless policies are flagged for review. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers plain-language intent per policy.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: "protect PII", 2: "", 3: "retain financials 7y for tax law"}
intent = CFG[LEVEL]
print("intent:", repr(intent) or "(missing)", "->", "recorded" if intent else "FLAGGED: intentless policy")
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.
